title: Button
purpose: 폼 제출, 저장, 확인처럼 사용자가 결과를 예상할 수 있는 단일 행동에 적합합니다. 아이콘만 필요한 좁은 도구 영역은 Icon Button, 배경 없는 보조 행동은 Text Button, 켬·끔 상태를 유지해야 하면 Toggle Icon을 사용하세요.
useWhen: 폼 제출, 저장, 확인처럼 사용자가 결과를 예상할 수 있는 단일 행동에 적합합니다. 아이콘만 필요한 좁은 도구 영역은 Icon Button, 배경 없는 보조 행동은 Text Button, 켬·끔 상태를 유지해야 하면 Toggle Icon을 사용하세요.

loading: prevents repeated activation, renders a spinner, and sets aria-busy; use loadingLabel for the single screen-reader name (기본값 불러오는 중). The existing content keeps its width while visually hidden, so loading does not move adjacent controls.
Hover and pressed feedback use calm tone changes only: no lift, scale, or shadow escalation. Focus remains the shared 2px :focus-visible outline.
Use IconButton for icon-only one-shot actions and ToggleIcon for icon-only persistent state actions.
avoidWhen: loading은 native disabled를 사용하지 않습니다. 대신 aria-disabled="true" 와 aria-busy="true"를 두고 activation만 차단합니다. native disabled로 만들면 방금 그 버튼을 누른 키보드 사용자의 focus가 즉시 로 튕기기 때문이며, Polaris·Carbon과 같은 처리입니다. 명시적인 disabled/disable만 tab 순서에서 제거합니다.
iconOnly는 접근 가능한 이름이 없으면 이름 없는 버튼이 됩니다. aria-label (또는 aria-labelledby)을 반드시 전달하세요. 누락 시 development 빌드에서만 console 경고가 출력되며 production 번들에서는 제거됩니다.
Disabled foreground, fill, and outlined border resolve semantic roles at the button's rendered theme scope, so nested dark surfaces do not inherit a root-resolved light alias.
arrow is deprecated and remains as a no-op compatibility prop.

anatomy.rule: Button의 semantic role, layout containment와 전달받은 DOM 속성을 소유합니다.
Render the icon-only square button treatment. Requires aria-label (or aria-labelledby); a development-only console warning fires when neither is supplied.
Screen-reader label announced with the loading spinner. @default "불러오는 중"
children 속성으로 제공되는 공개 슬롯 또는 표시 영역입니다.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual action variant mapped through LK theme tokens. Also accepts "solid" and "outlined". @default "primary"

properties.name: size
properties.description: Control height, padding, and text size. Aliases map small/medium/large to sm/md/lg. @default "md"

properties.name: full
properties.description: Fill the available container width. @default false

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disable activation and mark the control unavailable. @default false

properties.name: iconOnly
properties.description: Render the icon-only square button treatment. Requires aria-label (or aria-labelledby); a development-only console warning fires when neither is supplied.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Show the action loading state and prevent repeated activation. The control stays focusable while loading (aria-disabled + aria-busy rather than native disabled) so keyboard focus is not lost on activation.

properties.name: loadingLabel
properties.description: Screen-reader label announced with the loading spinner. @default "불러오는 중"

properties.name: as
properties.description: Render with another element or component, such as "a" for link CTAs. @default "button"

Native disabled removes a button from focus. aria-disabled="true" keeps it discoverable, applies the same unavailable treatment, and blocks activation.

quantitativeRules.subject: 명시 규칙 1
quantitativeRules.rule: Hover and pressed feedback use calm tone changes only: no lift, scale, or shadow escalation. Focus remains the shared 2px :focus-visible outline.

quantitativeRules.subject: 명시 규칙 2
quantitativeRules.rule: WCAG 2.2 contrast minimum requires 4.5:1 for normal-size button text.

quantitativeRules.subject: 명시 규칙 3
quantitativeRules.rule: Fluent 2 Button usage applies text contrast across interactive button states. LDS keeps ghost low emphasis through its transparent surface and border, not low-legibility text.

quantitativeRules.subject: 명시 규칙 4
quantitativeRules.rule: Fluent 2 Button의 단일 주요 액션과 toggle/split 역할 분리를 채택합니다.
